biotools.name: ODNA

metadata.abstract: Motivation: Identifying organellar DNA, such as mitochondrial or plastid sequences, inside a whole genome assembly, remains challenging and requires biological background knowledge. To address this, we developed ODNA based on genome annotation and machine learning to fulfill. Results: ODNA is a software that classifies organellar DNA sequences within a genome assembly by machine learning based on a predefined genome annotation workflow. We trained our model with 829 769 DNA sequences from 405 genome assemblies and achieved high predictive performance (e.g. matthew's correlation coefficient of 0.61 for mitochondria and 0.73 for chloroplasts) on independent validation data, thus outperforming existing approaches significantly.
metadata.title: ODNA: identification of organellar DNA by machine learning
